author: GamingBolt
description:
Pokémon Pokopia is bringing in a lot of new stuff, with many appealing features lurking beneath the surface of oceans that have been largely inaccessible until now. Well, the upcoming free update is bringing underwater exploration to the surface, while the first part of the expansion pass is introducing a whole new town for us to engage with.

That’s a potent combination in a title where building up towns can quickly become an obsession, and Buddy Basin is definitely a welcoming name for a place that we’re going to be calling home for quite a while. We’re taking a peek at what’s waiting under the peaceful waters, a look at a new biome absolutely brimming with things to do.
title: Pokemon Pokopia Bubbly Basin Expansion + New Updates - 10 BIGGEST Changes You Need To Know

author: GamingBolt
description: The first Mortal Shell is remembered as a small-scale project with promising foundations. Its execution didn’t always realise that promise, so developer Cold Symmetry has gone back to the drawing board, rebuilding the fundamentals to create a sequel which significantly overhauls the original’s combat, progression, traversal, and more. Here are the fifteen biggest differences.
title: Mortal Shell 2 vs Mortal Shell 1 - 15 Biggest Differences You MAY NOT KNOW

author: GamingBolt
description:
In 2026, however, the mood around Halo, the once-universally beloved first-person shooter is a little...odd. Halo: Campaign Evolved finally launched worldwide on July 29th after arriving in advanced access a few days prior. 

The first new entry, even if it is a remake, in almost five years. A return to where it all began in stunning detail courtesy of Unreal Engine 5, complete with new content in the form of three Prologue missions. Four-player co-op! No multiplayer, though, because Halo Studios aren't wizards, for crying out loud.
title: Halo Campaign Evolved - What The HELL Is Going On?
